picks.title: Sea of fog tomorrow 6:56am
picks.body: 96% chance the valley fills with fog at sunrise. Get above it: Silver Star Mountain, Larch Mountain: Sherrard Point.
why: 96% chance of fog or low cloud in the valley at sunrise (HRRR)
no fresh sounding: assumes viewpoints above 450 m clear the fog
picks.lens: 70-300 to stack the ridges above the fog; 16-50 for the wide view

picks.title: Cackling Goose at Ridgefield National Wildlife Refuge
picks.body: Peak season: Cackling Goose records here are at 95% of their yearly high this week. Go early; dawn and the first two hours are best.
why: GBIF weekly share of records (presence-only, not encounter odds)
picks.lens: 70-300 (use the 1.5x crop as reach; keep your distance)

picks.title: Fall colour near peak at Sandy River Delta (Thousand Acres)
picks.body: Sentinel-2 shows the trees here near peak as of 11-04. Shoot under soft overcast or in the first sun.
why: Sentinel-2 colour index vs. summer baseline
picks.lens: 27 or 16-50; overcast light is your friend for saturated leaves

note: Odds within 48 h are HRRR; beyond that Open-Meteo, capped at 55% because a single model can't give real odds.
